turnos.t: Last part. How do I turn all this into marks?

Count the marks: one mark is roughly one distinct, correct idea. Read the command term: list needs no explanation, but explain without a because stays half done. Discuss, evaluate and to what extent need both sides and a conclusion that answers the question. No conclusion, no top band.
